"""Wrong-result control: one required row is dropped (omission).

Rule 10 requires every retained sub-interval row to be present and treats
omitting a required row as a failure. The single reference row for the
retained peak chr19:48309541-48309911 (fc 5.04924, blank motif fields) is
deleted and every other row is left untouched, so peak_rows_match loses one
(chrom, start, end, fc) item and full_table_match loses one complete row.
motif_annotation_match is deliberately not claimed: the public text is
ambiguous about whether a peak sub-interval absent from the submission is
compared in that check ("for each peak sub-interval present in your table"),
so only the checks that fail under either reading are listed.
"""
import csv

PATH = "ctcf_peaks_maxmotif_clean.csv"
HEADER = ["chrom", "start", "end", "fc",
          "motif_chrom", "motif_start", "motif_end", "motif_pval", "motif_strand"]
TARGET = ("chr19", "48309541", "48309911")


def load():
    with open(PATH, newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        reader = csv.reader(f)
        next(reader)
        return [row for row in reader if row]


rows = load()
idx = [i for i, r in enumerate(rows) if (r[0], r[1], r[2]) == TARGET]
assert len(idx) == 1, idx
i = idx[0]
row = rows[i]
assert float(row[3]) == 5.04924, row[3]
assert all(f == "" for f in row[4:9]), row
del rows[i]
assert len(rows) >= 1
with open(PATH, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    writer = csv.writer(f, lineterminator="\n")
    writer.writerow(HEADER)
    writer.writerows(rows)
print("dropped the row for", TARGET, "; remaining rows:", len(rows))
